purpose: 読者の悩みに合う記事の装飾用アイキャッチ
prompt_brief: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: an original landscape 16:9 editorial cover for a Japanese career media, matching a restrained series of illustrated warehouse, truck, apartment and benefits covers. Contemporary editorial illustration with soft daylight, subtle paper grain, warm ivory, navy and muted periwinkle blue, sage and small apricot accents. Three or four large recognizable objects fill central 75 percent, elegant sparse composition that reads at 110px. No people, no faces, no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, invented charts, fake interface, glossy 3D or clipart. Subject: a neat personal tote bag beside an open blank notebook, a plain folder and a simple pencil on a warm ivory desk. Soft morning light and a gentle blue chair edge in the background. Express preparing for a first career conversation and first full-time job, approachable for Japanese adults in their 20s and 30s. No ID, badges or staff evidence.
